about: A second held-out set over the eval-basic.json memories, written after hybrid search was tuned (migration 0013) and never used to tune any retriever. Its first result is the honest check on that tuning: do not change a retriever to fit it, write a new set instead. Questions mix three kinds: paraphrases that share no words with their answer, partial overlaps, and questions whose words also appear in other memories. Made up: no real people, clients or places.
